blocks.content: Explore the top of Demo Wind Farm to see the text that introduces the dashboard and the links that point viewers to other pages.

blocks.title: Introduction and links on Demo Wind Farm

blocks.content: This text panel opens the dashboard with its purpose. It also names the data source and gives instructions for exploring a panel. A viewer gets this context without having to work it out from the panels, which helps make the dashboard easy to interpret.
View the first link in the dashboard.

Dashboard links are displayed at the top of the dashboard. You can add links like this to a dashboard. Links let you navigate between commonly used dashboards or connect viewers to your visualizations, with shortcuts to other dashboards, panels, and external websites.
